description: Phase 2 — FunctionCallExpression + ListLiteralExpression on the backend: closed FunctionName Literal allowlist covering the FULL design §4.3 + §4.6 catalog, per-function arity + is_in list-literal placement via model_validator, evaluator function registry honoring D3/D4/D5/D7/D8/D9/D10/D11, three-backend lowering tables with EXPLICIT hazard implementations (no language defaults), function/list-literal validation codes added to the expression-validation harness, and the full conformance + unit + property matrix. Implements design §4, §4.3, §4.5, §4.6, §14 D3-D11. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (shares the Expression union and the expression_validation.py harness). NO Alembic migration. Follows plan.md items 9-13.
steps: Read design.md §4, §4.3, §4.5, §4.6, §14 D3-D11 and plan.md items 9-13 FIRST. Never add a free-text/arbitrary-expression path (§13 rejected).

src/app/transformation/contracts.py: add FunctionName = closed Literal containing EVERY function — string: concat, substring, upper, lower, trim, length, contains, startswith, endswith, replace, index_of, scan_token, pad_left, pad_right; null/logical: coalesce, nullif, is_in, n_missing, n_present; numeric: round, floor, ceil, abs, modulo, min_of, max_of, truncate, safe_divide; date/datetime: parse_date, year, month, day, date_diff_days, parse_datetime, hour, minute, second, study_day, date_add_days, date_diff_months. Add FunctionCallExpression{kind: Literal['function']; function: FunctionName; arguments: tuple[Expression, ...]} and ListLiteralExpression{kind: Literal['list_literal']; values: tuple[str|int|float|bool|None, ...] = Field(min_length=1)}; add both to the Expression union. Add a model_validator(mode='after') on FunctionCallExpression enforcing per-function arity (fixed funcs exact; variadic concat/coalesce/min_of/max_of/n_missing/n_present min counts) and that a ListLiteralExpression appears ONLY as is_in's 2nd argument (and is_in requires it there).

src/app/transformation/evaluator.py _value: add kind=='list_literal' (return values tuple, consumed only by is_in) and kind=='function' dispatching through a registry dict[FunctionName, Callable]. Implement every catalog semantic: null-in->null-out default; coalesce/nullif/is_in null handling; D3 half-away-from-zero round + truncated (dividend-sign) modulo; D4 parse_date full YYYY-MM-DD only (partials->null); D5 ASCII/invariant upper/lower; D7 scan_token collapses consecutive delimiters; D8 study_day CDISC --DY no-day-zero; D9 date_diff_months continuous elapsed whole months; D10 parse_datetime naive/UTC only, offsets->null; D11 homogeneous arg types for min_of/max_of/n_missing/n_present. Preview codes preview_function_argument_invalid, preview_date_parse_invalid (422).

src/app/transformation/codegen.py: add per-backend lowering tables keyed by function name in _py_expr/_r_expr/_sas_expr plus list_literal handling (only inside is_in). Emit EXPLICIT hazard implementations: D3 round/modulo in all three; D7 scan_token delimiter-collapse in Py/R; D8 study_day formula; D9 date_diff_months continuous; D10 datetime naive/UTC. SAS native char/numeric selection (coalesce/coalescec, nmiss/cmiss, min/max via D11; IFN/IFC for nullif). Where a backend cannot preserve exact semantics raise UnsupportedOperator (-> BackendCapabilityMissing). Date functions compose only through parse_date/parse_datetime; keep SAS 1960 origin internal.

Extend src/app/transformation/expression_validation.py with expr_function_unknown (error), expr_function_arity (error), expr_function_arg_type (error; e.g. substring start/length not integer-typed, D11 heterogeneous args, replace empty find, pad_left/right non-single-char fill where statically decidable), expr_list_literal_misplaced (error; list literal outside is_in), expr_date_function_on_nondate (warning; date function on an expression not produced by parse_date/parse_datetime). Stable codes + field_path.

Extend tests/conformance/test_expression_conformance.py with a fixture plan exercising EVERY function and list_literal; generate Python+R, execute both, compare exact (string/int/bool/date) and tolerance (float: round, float abs, safe_divide); assert SAS generated (non-failing). Add tests/unit/test_transformation_functions.py (evaluator per-function, codegen golden per function, each new validation code) and tests/unit/test_transformation_functions_properties.py (Hypothesis: round-trip; 1-based substring/index_of boundaries; modulo/round negatives/boundaries; parse_date valid/partial/invalid; study_day boundaries event==reference->1 and event==reference-1->-1). Fixtures include missing values, empty-string-vs-null, non-ASCII, partial dates.
acceptance_criteria: uv run pytest tests/unit tests/conformance -q passes.

Every §4.3 + §4.6 function and list_literal compiles to Python/R with identical normalized outputs (exact or declared tolerance) and generates a SAS program; D3/D4/D5/D7/D8/D9/D10/D11 honored by explicit implementations, not language defaults.
expr_function_unknown/_arity/_arg_type, expr_list_literal_misplaced, expr_date_function_on_nondate fire correctly; is_in list literal valid only as its 2nd argument (contract-enforced).
uv run ruff check ., uv run ruff format --check ., uv run mypy src all pass; NO Alembic migration added.
verification: uv run ruff check .; uv run ruff format --check .; uv run mypy src
findings:
FEAT-002 Phase 2 landed on branch feature/typed-expression-expansion in the worktree (commit on top of FEAT-001). Handoff facts for FEAT-003 (frontend builder + OpenAPI/contract regeneration):

CONTRACT (src/app/transformation/contracts.py): added two new Expression kinds to the discriminated union (now 7 kinds: literal, column, unary, binary, conditional, function, list_literal). `FunctionCallExpression{kind: Literal['function']; function: FunctionName; arguments: tuple[Expression,...]}` with a model_validator(mode='after') enforcing (a) exact arity for fixed funcs via `_FUNCTION_ARITY`, (b) minimum arity for variadics via `_FUNCTION_MIN_ARITY`, and (c) a ListLiteralExpression may appear ONLY as is_in's 2nd argument and is_in REQUIRES one there. `ListLiteralExpression{kind: Literal['list_literal']; values: tuple[str|int|float|bool|None,...] min_length=1}`.

FUNCTIONNAME ENUM (as emitted to OpenAPI, exact closed Literal order; orval will generate a TS string enum for the `function` field of FunctionCallExpression): concat, substring, upper, lower, trim, length, contains, startswith, endswith, replace, index_of, scan_token, pad_left, pad_right, coalesce, nullif, is_in, n_missing, n_present, round, floor, ceil, abs, modulo, min_of, max_of, truncate, safe_divide, parse_date, year, month, day, date_diff_days, parse_datetime, hour, minute, second, study_day, date_add_days, date_diff_months. (40 functions = full §4.3 + §4.6 catalog.)

ARITIES the frontend FunctionFields editor must honor (reset arguments on function change): FIXED-ARITY -> substring=3, upper/lower/trim/length=1, contains/startswith/endswith=2, replace=3, index_of=2, scan_token=3, pad_left/pad_right=3, nullif=2, is_in=2, round=2, floor/ceil/abs=1, modulo=2, truncate=1, safe_divide=2, parse_date=1, year/month/day=1, date_diff_days=2, parse_datetime=1, hour/minute/second=1, study_day=2, date_add_days=2, date_diff_months=2. VARIADIC (min count) -> concat>=1, coalesce>=1, min_of>=1, max_of>=1, n_missing>=1, n_present>=1. The is_in editor must render arg[0] as a normal ExpressionBuilder and arg[1] as a ListLiteralExpression typed value-list editor (never free text beyond individual literal values) — enforced server-side by the model_validator.

EVALUATOR (src/app/transformation/evaluator.py): `_value` now handles kind=='list_literal' (returns the values tuple, consumed only by is_in) and kind=='function' (evaluates args then dispatches through app.transformation.expression_functions.REGISTRY; catches ExpressionFunctionError and re-raises as a 422 ProblemException with code 'preview_function_argument_invalid' or 'preview_date_parse_invalid').

NEW MODULE (src/app/transformation/expression_functions.py): the single Python reference implementation of all 40 catalog semantics under D3-D11. Exposes REGISTRY: dict[str, Callable[[Sequence[Scalar]], Scalar]] plus reusable helpers half_away_round (D3), truncated_modulo (D3), parse_full_date (D4), parse_naive_datetime (D10), study_day (D8), date_diff_months (D9). ExpressionFunctionError carries a stable `code`.

CODEGEN (src/app/transformation/codegen.py): _py_expr lowers functions to `fn_<name>([args])` (is_in -> `fn_is_in(value, (candidates,))`), list_literal -> a Python tuple. A new `_PY_FUNCTION_PREAMBLE` constant (emitted inside python_source) defines all fn_* helpers self-contained (no app import). _r_expr lowers to `aur_<name>(args)` / `aur_is_in(value, list(...))`; a new `_R_FUNCTION_PREAMBLE` constant (emitted inside r_source) defines vectorized aur_* helpers. _sas_expr delegates functions to new `_sas_function(expression, result_type)` with native char/numeric selection (coalesce/coalescec, nmiss/cmiss, n/cmiss-count, ifc/ifn for nullif), explicit D3 round (sign*round(abs,10**-d)) and modulo (truncated), explicit D8 study_day formula, D9 date_diff_months via intck 'C', naive/UTC datetime. SAS DATE/DATETIME functions compose ONLY through parse_date/parse_datetime/date_add_days via `_sas_date`/`_sas_datetime` helpers that raise UnsupportedOperator('date_function_requires_parse_date'/'datetime_function_requires_parse_datetime') otherwise -> compile_dataflow maps to BackendCapabilityMissing. is_in null list members and any other unlowerable case also raise UnsupportedOperator. Banner/compiler_version unchanged at 1.5.0 from FEAT-001.

VALIDATION (src/app/transformation/expression_validation.py): EXTENDED the existing single validator (did NOT create a second). `_walk` now recurses into function arguments and reports list_literal placement. New stable codes exported: EXPR_FUNCTION_UNKNOWN (error), EXPR_FUNCTION_ARITY (error), EXPR_FUNCTION_ARG_TYPE (error: non-integer substring/scan/pad/round/modulo/date_add_days integer slots, empty replace find, non-single-char pad fill, D11 heterogeneous min_of/max_of/n_missing/n_present), EXPR_LIST_LITERAL_MISPLACED (error), EXPR_DATE_FUNCTION_ON_NONDATE (warning: date/datetime function whose date arg is not statically produced by parse_date/parse_datetime/date_add_days). sdtm/routes.py::validate_plan already runs this validator over authored plan expressions via _plan_expressions and needs no change.

SERIALIZATION NOTE for conformance/frontend: parse_date/date_add_days emit date values that both Python (csv str(date)) and R (format %Y-%m-%d) render as 'YYYY-MM-DD'; parse_datetime renders 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. Boolean function results serialize as Python True/False vs R TRUE/FALSE — identical semantics, compare case-insensitively (handled in the conformance test's _BOOLEAN_COLUMNS set). Float results (round/abs/safe_divide/min_of/max_of) compare with tolerance 1e-9, not exact (Python '3.0' vs R '3').

VERIFICATION: uv run ruff check . + mypy src clean; uv run pytest tests/unit tests/conformance -q => 175 passed (R executed via Rscript); tests/contract => 17 passed. NO Alembic migration added. OpenAPI widening is additive (D6, no /api/v1 bump) but NOT yet regenerated — FEAT-003 must run `npm run api:sync` so frontend/openapi.json + frontend/src/api/generated/** pick up the two new kinds and the FunctionName enum, update tests/contract OpenAPI fixtures if any assert the Expression shape, and build the conditional + function editors in expression-builder.tsx (which is untracked/absent in the worktree and must be copied over first per context.json).
